completeness_assessment.issue: Supplier table description is generic ('Contains schema metadata...') and does not match semantic model's detailed description

accuracy_assessment.issue: Glossary shows timestamp type as 'TIMESTAMP(29,6)' while semantic model shows 'TIMESTAMP' without precision
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Standardize timestamp type representation between glossary and semantic model

accuracy_assessment.issue: Glossary describes customer.total_spend as 'Cumulative monetary amount the customer has spent' but does not include the critical warning about double-counting when joined to order_tbl
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Add warning to glossary: 'Do not sum this field after joining to order_tbl as it will cause double counting. Use order_tbl.total for order-level revenue analysis.'

accuracy_assessment.issue: Glossary uses 'INT4' for capacity field type while semantic model uses 'INTEGER'
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Standardize integer type naming convention across both artifacts

accuracy_assessment.issue: Glossary shows PII flag 'Yes' for payment_method but semantic model does not explicitly mark it as PII
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Align PII classification between artifacts or document rationale for difference

efficiency_assessment.issue: Multiple metrics calculate similar aggregations (e.g., average_order_value, revenue_per_customer, orders_per_customer all use similar CASE/division patterns)
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider creating reusable calculation templates or CTEs for common ratio/average patterns

efficiency_assessment.issue: Three table descriptions in glossary use identical generic text: 'Contains schema metadata, system-level attributes...' (shipment, store, supplier)
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Replace generic descriptions with table-specific business descriptions matching semantic model detail level

efficiency_assessment.issue: Multiple metrics (monthly_revenue, revenue_growth_mom, running_total_revenue) independently calculate monthly revenue aggregation
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Refactor to use a shared monthly_revenue CTE that can be reused across time-based metrics

efficiency_assessment.issue: Several 'top N' ranking metrics (top_customers_by_revenue, top_stores_by_revenue, top_suppliers_by_rating) use similar RANK() OVER patterns
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Create a parameterized ranking template or view that accepts entity type and measure as parameters

efficiency_assessment.issue: Multiple metrics include identical zero-division protection CASE statements
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider using NULLIF in denominators (e.g., 'SUM(total) / NULLIF(COUNT(order_id), 0)') for cleaner, more maintainable code
